reviews.review: Can someone please explain to me why gamers are happy with any crappy game put out nowaday? Legit all this game is hunt the same few bugs that DONT drop loot and the same generated environments to grind for a little character improvement. Thats all there is to this game?  CAN SOMEONE PLEASE enlighten me on why this is what we settle with nowaday?

This game is the most fun I've had with co-op since Diablo 2.   I can't overstate how well done this game is - the music, character classes, environments, missions and mechanics are all dialed in.  And every mission can go from breezy to "oh lawd we all ded" in a heartbeat.  The first time an exploder bug set off a chain reaction that caused huge stalactites to fall from the ceiling and fissures to open up in the floor... wow. 

You won't regret purchasing this.  Even solo missions are awesome.   And it looks like the short term roadmap has planned updates that are going to make the progression and weapons systems even better.

Would love to see some attention to a few more polishing items for the core gameplay.  For example, getting rid of the "floater" polygons that are left after mining sometimes, and the occassional M.U.L.E. never pathing it's way back to the droppod...  but honestly the issues hardly detract from the fun.  This is easily the best money I've spent on a game in the last two years.

I'm nominating this for the "Best with Friends" award for 2018.   It's like a better version of Left for Dead 2, which was the last time I had this much fun hanging out with people online.
9/10, its updates are promising which will give it a good ol 15/10.

I really enjoy this game! It has some of the best class balancing I've seen yet. Every class is unique and fun, bringing its own style of gameplay and utility to the team. None of them are flat-out better, or flat-out worse than the others. The cave generation is fantastic too! There are many biomes available already and they all have their own twist in how their caves spawn, so no two biomes (or missions) feel the same.
